en.headline:
Life lists, on paper.
Share a snapshot.
en.intro: Collect experiences and everyday tasks in notebooks, mark them off, and compare a shared list with someone else.
en.concept_title: A notebook for each kind of list.
en.concept: Start with the bundled 100 Life List, or make a notebook for travel, shopping or the things you want to try. Each notebook keeps its own items and completion marks.
features: Desktop notebooks have a cover, ruled pages and a back cover. Each content page holds ten items. Open the stack to move through them; mobile uses a compact list.
Tap the punched-hole checkbox. A yellow marker stroke keeps completed items readable. When all ten items on a full page are checked, that page moves to the completed stack.
Make room for your own items
Add or remove items inside a notebook and add blank pages. The gallery keeps separate notebooks together, so a grocery list does not have to share a page with life goals.
en.compare_intro: A shared link contains one notebook and the sender’s marks at the time it was made. Open it, review your own answers, then choose Compare this group.
en.demo_note: A small unsaved example using the app’s four comparison rules. These sample items come from the bundled list; English labels are explanatory translations.
en.snapshot_title: A link carries a copy, not a live room.
en.snapshot_body: The app compresses the selected notebook and its completion marks into the link’s query string. The QR code contains the same link. Later changes do not update a link you already sent; create a new one to compare again.
steps: Choose the default list, or use New Notebook to create a separate group. Open its stack and move past the cover.
Keep the list personal. Add a task or experience, then tap its checkbox when you have done it.
Use Share Link or QR Code. Review what the notebook contains before passing the link to someone.
The recipient opens the snapshot, checks their own items, then selects Compare this group to see the four result groups.
captions: Default notebook gallery, using bundled data.
The real notebook stack and cover.
A page with two demonstration completion marks.
The real comparison view, with clearly staged bundled-data answers.
en.storage: Notebooks, marks and page state are kept in this browser’s local storage. No account or remote list database is needed for the current workspace. Another browser or app address has a separate copy; clearing site data can remove your records.
en.security: The local archive uses encryption, but its key is derived from an identifier stored in the same browser. It is not a password vault. Shared links use compression, not encryption: anyone with a link can read the included notebook and marks. Avoid putting private material in a link.
en.run_note: The ordinary notebook and comparison flows do not need an AI key or account. Use the URL printed by Vite. A saved link is a snapshot, not a complete automatic backup of every notebook.
en.footer: A Frankie project by Songhai Fan

zh.headline:
把清单装订成册，
分享完成的记录。
zh.intro: 用笔记本收纳人生体验与日常任务，逐项标记，再与另一个人的同一份清单比较。
zh.concept: 从内置的「100 Life List」开始，也可以为旅行、购物或想尝试的事新建笔记本。每一本都有自己的条目与完成记录。
features: 桌面端有封面、横线内页与封底，每张内页容纳十项。打开卡片堆即可逐页浏览；手机端则使用紧凑的列表。
轻点打孔式复选框，黄色荧光笔会划过已完成的文字，内容仍然可读。完整一页的十项全部勾选后，会移入已完成的卡片堆。
在笔记本中添加、移除条目，也能增加空白页。总览收纳多本笔记本，购物清单不必和人生目标挤在同一页。
zh.compare_title: 看看两个人分别完成了什么。
zh.compare_intro: 分享链接包含生成时那一本笔记本及发送者的勾选记录。打开后先查看并填写自己的答案，再点击「对比这一组」。
zh.demo_note: 这是采用应用四类对比规则的小型示例，不会保存。条目取自内置清单。
zh.snapshot_title: 分享的是副本，不是实时房间。
zh.snapshot_body: 应用把所选笔记本与完成记录压缩到链接的查询参数里，二维码包含同一条链接。之后的修改不会自动更新已发送的链接；想再次对齐，就生成新的链接。
zh.workflow_title: 第一本清单，从这里开始
steps: 选择内置清单，或点 New Notebook 新建分组。打开卡片堆，翻过封面。
把想做、想经历的事写进去，完成后点击复选框。
使用 Share Link 或 QR Code。发送前先检查这本笔记本的内容。
填写自己的答案再比较
接收者打开快照，勾选自己的条目，再点「对比这一组」，查看四类结果。
captions: 使用内置数据的默认笔记本总览。
真实的笔记本卡片堆与封面。
使用两个演示勾选记录的内页。
使用内置数据与明确安排的示例答案，展示真实对比界面。
zh.storage_title: 无需账号，记录留在本地。
zh.storage: 笔记本、勾选与书页状态保存在当前浏览器的本地存储里。现有清单流程不需要账号或远程清单数据库。换一个浏览器或应用地址，就是另一份数据；清理站点数据可能移除记录。
zh.security: 本地存档采用加密，但密钥由同一浏览器里保存的标识生成，因此它不是密码保险箱。分享链接使用压缩而非加密，拿到链接的人可以读取其中的笔记本与勾选。不要把私密内容放进分享链接。
zh.run_note: 日常笔记本和对比不需要 AI key 或账号，打开 Vite 输出的地址即可。分享链接只是一份快照，不会自动完整备份所有笔记本。
zh.footer: Songhai Fan 的 Frankie 系列项目
